name: @tejoma/dynamic-weighting-service
description: Tejoma Dynamic Weighting / Explainable Matching Service - Tier 0 (Batch 33, seventh slice of the Matching domain). Ports the confirmed-dormant Dynamic Weighting scoring path (resolveSkillTiers, computeSeniorityAdjustedWeights, computeDynamicSkillScore from dynamicWeighting.ts), its explanation layer (explainability.ts singular - NOT the separate, genuinely live explainability/ folder, which stays on the monolith untouched), and Hybrid Retrieval (retrieval.ts). Every one of these is reachable only via matchingApi.ts's `weighting: 'dynamic'` / `retrieval` options, neither of which any real caller anywhere in this repository ever sets (confirmed via grep) - genuinely zero real traffic today, unlike every other batch. No owned table: this service computes and returns, it never persists anything. Owns read-only dual-write mirrors of skill_nodes, skill_edges, and role_profiles.
